reason: The goal bear-trap-capture's second slice has landed: trap.c mintrap()'s mtmp->mtrapped arm is ported for the bear trap, monmove.c m_move()'s prologue calls it, and trap.c trapname() exists in js/trap.js. js/trap_effects.js:811's refusal and the resolveTrappedMonster injection are gone, and js/unported_monster_actions.js's 'a trapped monster' gate now reads the square rather than the mtrapped bit. Two entries remain missing: do.c heal_legs() and the timeout.c nh_timeout() case that reaches it, which is slice 3 and carries 120 of the goal's 137 steps.

boundary.startingEvent: A monster completes a move onto a square holding a bear trap, so monmove.c postmov() calls mintrap() and its already-ported dispatch reaches trapeffect_selector(); or, for the third slice, any turn on which the hero's wounded-legs timeout counts down to zero in timeout.c nh_timeout(), which js/allmain.js:684 reaches every turn.
boundary.endingEvent: The trapped monster pulls free at mintrap()'s !rn2(40), and the hero's own bear-trap wound ends with heal_legs() drawing 'Your leg feels better.  Your movements are now unencumbered.' In seed0004-feeding-pony the boundary runs from step 34 to step 170; step 171 types a count prefix, which js/cmd.js:1920 refuses through readSimpleCommand(), and that refusal is the cap rather than part of this goal.
boundary.validInputs: Any seed, date and options whose D:1 places a bear trap a monster can walk onto, plus the hero walking onto one. seed0004-feeding-pony is the only development session that reaches the boundary: seed 4, datetime 20260414173108, OPTIONS=symset:DECgraphics, one segment. autopickup is off by its optlist.h:184 default, so js/hack.js:918 cannot interfere.
boundary.observables: Every screen, cursor and random-number call from the monster's completed move through the escape, and from the wounded-legs countdown through heal_legs(). The order-sensitive ones are d(2,4) at trap.c:1554, which C spends eleven keystrokes after the pline_mon() at 1534 suspends on a --More--, and the per-turn rn2(40) at trap.c:3751.
boundary.exclusions: The count prefix at step 171 and everything after it, including hack.c moverock() at step 203 and #loot at 238. dog.c keepdogs()'s trapped-follower line, refused at js/dog.js:657, which needs a level change while a pet is trapped. heal_legs()'s how == 1 dismount and how == 2 petrification arms. trapeffect_bear_trap()'s two remaining hero branches, the mounted arm at C 1507-1511 and the iron-shoes line at C 1517-1518, which preflight_dotrap() refuses ahead of the move. mintrap()'s pit and metallivore machinery, which no bear trap reaches.

Its search domain was the four already-recorded catch seeds whose pony survives, each extended by ninety searches and read back from the port's own rn2(40) draws; seed 7005082's roll of zero lands at step 15, inside the thirty-two held turns the port reaches before an unrelated pet-combat boundary. Getting a bear trap into a fresh case at all remains seed-search-only: apply.c set_trap() is unported at js/apply.js:93, doapply() refuses the tool by object type at js/apply.js:275, and wizgenesis and wizmap are unported. sourceReview: Every branch and helper reachable inside the boundary was traced against nethack-c/upstream/ rather than inferred, by the slice-selector at a4e9d83 and recorded here at 8a25741. The trace covered state, message order and random-number order: d(2,4) at trap.c:1554 sits eleven keystrokes after the pline_mon() at 1534 suspends, and rn2(40) at trap.c:3751 recurs once per trapped turn. Stubs, stops and partial implementations are identified individually above: four refusal sites (js/trap_effects.js:491 and :811, js/unported_monster_actions.js:229-230, js/timeout.js:277-280), one injection standing in for a real function (resolveTrappedMonster at js/unported_monster_actions.js:712, seam js/monmove.js:2503), one function absent from js/ entirely (trapname()), and one partial port that counts down but does not act (js/timeout.js's WOUNDED_LEGS handling). Two claims in the goal's own detail were corrected by this reading and are corrected here: the detail says lifting the trap arm without the unported_monster_actions.js gate 'earns nothing', but C's log shows that gate firing at the pony's next action at step 46, so slice 1 earns steps 34-45; and the detail's four refusal sites omit that trapname() has five refusing callers of which this goal lifts none, because each of the other four needs its own surrounding branch. Slice 1 landed the monster arm at 1525-1558 entire; the four refusal sites it names are now three, js/trap_effects.js:491 having been replaced by the arm itself. Two of the arm's six branches are recorded as cannot-occur rather than done because this boundary cannot reach them, and each carries the specific upstream condition that prevents it. Slice 2 landed the mtrapped arm, m_move()'s prologue and trapname(). One claim in this file's own candidate list was corrected by porting it: mintrap()'s mtrapped arm can return neither Trap_Killed_Mon nor Trap_Moved_Mon, so m_move():1736's death arm is dead in C as well as in the port and is carried with a comment rather than tested. The refusal sites this goal opened with are down to one, js/timeout.js:277-280, which slice 3 lifts.
